PluginData.Author: TomasServo
PluginData.Tooltip: Streams atomic.fm from Icecast into the Space Engineers client.
PluginData.Description:
atomic.fm streams a configurable Icecast URL through the local Windows audio device.
How to use: 1. Enable atomic.fm in Pulsar. 2. Add this to any terminal block's Custom Data: atomic.fm=true atomic.fm.range=35 atomic.fm.volume=1.0 3. Load into a world near that block. The stream starts automatically when a marked block is found. 4. Use Ctrl+Alt+J or the plugin settings buttons to toggle playback manually.
Notes: - Audio is client-side. Each player chooses whether to install and enable the plugin. - Marked blocks act as ambient radio anchors with distance fade and stereo panning. - If no marked blocks exist, manual playback still works through the local Windows audio device.
